{
  "schema_version": "1.1",
  "chapters": [
    {
      "chapter_id": 7,
      "title": "Rebooting for the Sequel",
      "chapter_role": "aftermath",
      "goal": "Set up the long-term quest to fix (or further break) the world.",
      "pacing": {
        "expected_scene_count": 8,
        "intensity": 2,
        "tempo": "slow_burn"
      },
      "bridge": {
        "from_prev": "Artie is in the Null-Zone.",
        "to_next": "Book 2: The Quest for the Source Code."
      },
      "stakes_shift": "Artie is now the most wanted entity in the multiverse.",
      "sections": [
        {
          "section_id": 1,
          "title": "The New Normal",
          "intent": "Establish the new status quo for Artie and Fizz.",
          "end_condition": "Artie realizes his immortality is just as annoying as his 1 HP build.",
          "scenes": [
            {
              "scene_id": 1,
              "type": "setup",
              "summary": "Artie learns how to eat 'Data-Packets' instead of food, accidentally critting one and causing a minor physics explosion.",
              "outcome": "Artie adapts to his new existence.",
              "characters": [
                "CHAR_ARTIE",
                "CHAR_FIZZ"
              ],
              "threads": [
                "THREAD_SYSTEM_GLITCH",
                "THREAD_CRIT_EXPLOIT"
              ],
              "location_start_label": "Null-Zone - Data Stream",
              "location_start": "Null-Zone - Data Stream",
              "location_start_id": "LOC_NULL_ZONE_DATA_STREAM_F4D57D",
              "location_end_label": "Null-Zone - Data Stream",
              "location_end": "Null-Zone - Data Stream",
              "location_end_id": "LOC_NULL_ZONE_DATA_STREAM_F4D57D",
              "handoff_mode": "arrival_checkpoint",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "transition_in_text": "Artie reaches out to touch a floating cube of light.",
              "transition_in_anchors": [
                "data packet cube",
                "digital hunger",
                "wireframe landscape",
                "glowing stream"
              ],
              "transition_out_text": "Fizz points toward a distant, glowing tower on the horizon.",
              "transition_out_anchors": [
                "server room tower",
                "world center",
                "long-term quest",
                "digital horizon"
              ],
              "hands_off_to": "7:2"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 2,
              "type": "reveal",
              "summary": "Fizz explains that the only way to save the world is to reach the 'Server Room' at the center of the world.",
              "outcome": "The long-term goal is established.",
              "characters": [
                "CHAR_ARTIE",
                "CHAR_FIZZ"
              ],
              "threads": [
                "THREAD_THE_ASCENSION",
                "THREAD_SYSTEM_GLITCH"
              ],
              "location_start_label": "Null-Zone - Data Stream",
              "location_start": "Null-Zone - Data Stream",
              "location_start_id": "LOC_NULL_ZONE_DATA_STREAM_F4D57D",
              "location_end_label": "Null-Zone - Data Stream",
              "location_end": "Null-Zone - Data Stream",
              "location_end_id": "LOC_NULL_ZONE_DATA_STREAM_F4D57D",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "consumes_outcome_from": "7:1",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "transition_in_text": "Fizz's voice is solemn as she explains their new mission.",
              "transition_in_anchors": [
                "server room tower",
                "world center",
                "long-term quest",
                "digital horizon"
              ],
              "transition_out_text": "Artie stands at the edge of a wireframe cliff, testing his new body.",
              "transition_out_anchors": [
                "clipping glitch",
                "top of cliff",
                "annoying immortality",
                "wireframe clouds"
              ],
              "hands_off_to": "7:3"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 3,
              "type": "choice",
              "summary": "Artie tests his 'NaN' HP by jumping off a cliff; he doesn't die, he just clips through the floor and ends up back at the top.",
              "outcome": "Artie realizes his immortality is just as annoying as his 1 HP build.",
              "characters": [
                "CHAR_ARTIE"
              ],
              "threads": [
                "THREAD_SYSTEM_GLITCH",
                "THREAD_CRIT_EXPLOIT"
              ],
              "location_start_label": "Null-Zone - The Cliffside",
              "location_start": "Null-Zone - The Cliffside",
              "location_start_id": "LOC_NULL_ZONE_THE_CLIFFSIDE_D844EF",
              "location_end_label": "Null-Zone - The Cliffside",
              "location_end": "Null-Zone - The Cliffside",
              "location_end_id": "LOC_NULL_ZONE_THE_CLIFFSIDE_D844EF",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "consumes_outcome_from": "7:2",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "end_condition_echo": "Artie realizes his immortality is just as annoying as his 1 HP build.",
              "transition_in_text": "Artie takes a deep breath and steps off the edge.",
              "transition_in_anchors": [
                "clipping glitch",
                "top of cliff",
                "annoying immortality",
                "wireframe clouds"
              ],
              "transition_out_text": "Artie's descent is a blur of unrendered air until he snaps back to the ledge, where a group of heavily armed figures is waiting by a static campfire.",
              "transition_out_anchors": [
                "beta tester badges",
                "mismatched gear",
                "static campfire",
                "hidden cave"
              ],
              "hands_off_to": "7:4"
            }
          ]
        },
        {
          "section_id": 2,
          "title": "The Resistance",
          "intent": "Introduce the faction that will help Artie in the future.",
          "end_condition": "The series arc is locked in with the quest 'Delete the Admin'.",
          "scenes": [
            {
              "scene_id": 4,
              "type": "transition",
              "summary": "A group of 'Beta-Testers' led by a veteran survivor finds Artie in the Null-Zone and mentions they are tracking a dangerous anomaly.",
              "outcome": "Artie finds allies who know the world's secrets.",
              "characters": [
                "CHAR_ARTIE",
                "CHAR_BETA_LEADER"
              ],
              "introduces": [
                "CHAR_BETA_LEADER"
              ],
              "threads": [
                "THREAD_THE_ASCENSION",
                "THREAD_VANE_RIVALRY"
              ],
              "location_start_label": "Null-Zone - Hidden Camp",
              "location_start": "Null-Zone - Hidden Camp",
              "location_start_id": "LOC_NULL_ZONE_HIDDEN_CAMP_96A1E2",
              "location_end_label": "Null-Zone - Hidden Camp",
              "location_end": "Null-Zone - Hidden Camp",
              "location_end_id": "LOC_NULL_ZONE_HIDDEN_CAMP_96A1E2",
              "handoff_mode": "arrival_checkpoint",
              "consumes_outcome_from": "7:3",
              "constraint_state": "sheltered",
              "transition_in_text": "The figures approach cautiously, their weapons lowered as they emerge from the flickering static of the lower valley.",
              "transition_in_anchors": [
                "beta tester badges",
                "mismatched gear",
                "static campfire",
                "hidden cave"
              ],
              "transition_out_text": "The lead tester pulls up a holographic map of the world, the blue light illuminating the grim faces of the camp.",
              "transition_out_anchors": [
                "patch-hunter icon",
                "upgraded vane",
                "holographic map",
                "red alert"
              ],
              "hands_off_to": "7:5"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 5,
              "type": "reveal",
              "summary": "The Beta-Testers reveal that Vane is still alive and has been 'upgraded' by the System to be a 'Patch-Hunter'.",
              "outcome": "The rivalry continues with higher stakes.",
              "characters": [
                "CHAR_ARTIE",
                "CHAR_BETA_LEADER"
              ],
              "threads": [
                "THREAD_VANE_RIVALRY",
                "THREAD_THE_ASCENSION"
              ],
              "location_start_label": "Null-Zone - Hidden Camp",
              "location_start": "Null-Zone - Hidden Camp",
              "location_start_id": "LOC_NULL_ZONE_HIDDEN_CAMP_96A1E2",
              "location_end_label": "Null-Zone - Hidden Camp",
              "location_end": "Null-Zone - Hidden Camp",
              "location_end_id": "LOC_NULL_ZONE_HIDDEN_CAMP_96A1E2",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "consumes_outcome_from": "7:4",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "transition_in_text": "The holographic map flickers, showing a red icon moving toward them with predatory intent.",
              "transition_in_anchors": [
                "patch-hunter icon",
                "upgraded vane",
                "holographic map",
                "red alert"
              ],
              "transition_out_text": "A legendary quest notification appears in Artie's vision, the text burning with a golden intensity.",
              "transition_out_anchors": [
                "legendary quest banner",
                "delete admin text",
                "series arc lock",
                "golden glow"
              ],
              "hands_off_to": "7:6"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 6,
              "type": "reveal",
              "summary": "Artie receives his first 'Legendary' quest: 'Delete the Admin', which is the only way to stop Vane and fix the System.",
              "outcome": "The series arc is locked in.",
              "characters": [
                "CHAR_ARTIE",
                "CHAR_FIZZ",
                "CHAR_BETA_LEADER"
              ],
              "threads": [
                "THREAD_THE_ASCENSION",
                "THREAD_SYSTEM_GLITCH",
                "THREAD_VANE_RIVALRY"
              ],
              "location_start_label": "Null-Zone - Hidden Camp",
              "location_start": "Null-Zone - Hidden Camp",
              "location_start_id": "LOC_NULL_ZONE_HIDDEN_CAMP_96A1E2",
              "location_end_label": "Null-Zone - Hidden Camp",
              "location_end": "Null-Zone - Hidden Camp",
              "location_end_id": "LOC_NULL_ZONE_HIDDEN_CAMP_96A1E2",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "consumes_outcome_from": "7:5",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "end_condition_echo": "The series arc is locked in with the quest 'Delete the Admin'.",
              "transition_in_text": "The golden banner of the quest fills the camp with light, drowning out the dim glow of the static fire.",
              "transition_in_anchors": [
                "legendary quest banner",
                "delete admin text",
                "series arc lock",
                "golden glow"
              ],
              "transition_out_text": "With the quest accepted, the Beta-Testers pack up their static campfire and lead Artie toward the portal coordinates.",
              "transition_out_anchors": [
                "packed bags",
                "determined faces",
                "portal coordinates",
                "camp breakdown"
              ],
              "hands_off_to": "7:7"
            }
          ]
        },
        {
          "section_id": 3,
          "title": "The First Step",
          "intent": "End on a high note of action and anticipation.",
          "end_condition": "Artie steps into a portal, ending Book 1.",
          "scenes": [
            {
              "scene_id": 7,
              "type": "transition",
              "summary": "Artie and his new allies prepare to leave the Null-Zone and head to the 'Glitch-Woods'.",
              "outcome": "The journey begins anew.",
              "characters": [
                "CHAR_ARTIE",
                "CHAR_FIZZ",
                "CHAR_BETA_LEADER"
              ],
              "threads": [
                "THREAD_THE_ASCENSION"
              ],
              "location_start_label": "Null-Zone - Portal Gate",
              "location_start": "Null-Zone - Portal Gate",
              "location_start_id": "LOC_NULL_ZONE_PORTAL_GATE_D3FA54",
              "location_end_label": "Null-Zone - Portal Gate",
              "location_end": "Null-Zone - Portal Gate",
              "location_end_id": "LOC_NULL_ZONE_PORTAL_GATE_D3FA54",
              "handoff_mode": "arrival_checkpoint",
              "consumes_outcome_from": "7:6",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "transition_in_text": "The group arrives at the coordinates, and the Beta-Testers activate a swirling vortex of code, the portal's edges fraying into the surrounding trees.",
              "transition_in_anchors": [
                "packed bags",
                "determined faces",
                "portal coordinates",
                "camp breakdown"
              ],
              "transition_out_text": "Artie takes a final look at the wireframe world, his hand hovering over the swirling event horizon.",
              "transition_out_anchors": [
                "swirling portal",
                "event horizon",
                "fading light",
                "wireframe ground"
              ],
              "hands_off_to": "7:8"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 8,
              "type": "aftermath",
              "summary": "Artie looks at the sky and says, 'I hope the next world has better drop rates,' before stepping into a portal.",
              "outcome": "End of Book 1.",
              "characters": [
                "CHAR_ARTIE"
              ],
              "threads": [
                "THREAD_CRIT_EXPLOIT",
                "THREAD_SYSTEM_GLITCH"
              ],
              "location_start_label": "Null-Zone - Portal Gate",
              "location_start": "Null-Zone - Portal Gate",
              "location_start_id": "LOC_NULL_ZONE_PORTAL_GATE_D3FA54",
              "location_end_label": "Null-Zone - Portal Gate",
              "location_end": "Null-Zone - Portal Gate",
              "location_end_id": "LOC_NULL_ZONE_PORTAL_GATE_D3FA54",
              "handoff_mode": "time_skip",
              "consumes_outcome_from": "7:7",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "end_condition_echo": "Artie steps into a portal, ending Book 1.",
              "transition_in_text": "Artie's foot touches the edge of the swirling vortex, the code beginning to pull him in.",
              "transition_in_anchors": [
                "swirling portal",
                "event horizon",
                "fading light",
                "wireframe ground"
              ]
            }
          ]
        }
      ]
    }
  ]
}
